name: Find the population behind a reported rate

uses.action: Stretch the reply cord across four respondents and then across all six households before sending the runner.

name: Compare a quotation with the primary text

uses.action: Set both stops over the chalked fragment, then wind the uncropped cylinder before carrying the approved edition.

name: Identify who and where a study sampled

uses.action: Send Venn along a named sampling route and inspect the households included before deciding who will receive the result.

name: Follow a stable identifier to its record

uses.action: Follow the surviving W–17 shelf mark to the witness’s wax-cylinder loan record.

name: Check place evidence behind a public report

uses.action: Stand at Havra’s lookout and check which landing her signed slip covers before acting on the stall’s closure notice.
Check the location in the earlier still against the stone stair and its current tide instruction.

name: Compare a witness’s account with an instrument record

uses.action: Give your account of the bell stair, then compare its first and returning bands in the tuning glass before sharing the two observations.

name: Turn findings from a failure into a revised practice

uses.action: Replace the assumed two-beat crossing with the walked time and post a route retested behind the fog shutter.

name: Test whether a fitted pattern survives a fresh observation

uses.action: Test the model’s two-beat bridge against a fresh walk uphill and downhill, then send a new measured run to the shift.

name: Trace what changes when a network loses a hub

uses.action: Remove the shared optical tower with the fog shutter. Send one runner down each lane to find what still reaches the houses.

name: Check whether repeated observations are independent

uses.action: Trace two apparently corroborating notices back through the same press issue, then stand at the independent lookout.

name: Adapt the precision of a claim to two audiences

uses.action: Offer the full testimony for one listener or carry the short, bounded wording the witness permits a crowd to read.

name: Let the opening signal the route of the argument

uses.action: Choose which record opens the hearing and put a different source second. Listen to the exchange that this order produces.

name: Replace a long phrase with precise words

uses.action: Fit Sefa’s translated warning on one slate. Trade word length against the distinctions that the walkers, cart and rope carriers need.

name: Make the referent of a pronoun recoverable

uses.action: Restore the phrase that identifies which bell the girl means by “it” and decide how the next listener will receive it.

name: Earn the final synthesis from earlier evidence

uses.action: Build the signed finding from two identifiable records. The second witness limits what the first may claim.

name: Test whether a new reader can use the account

uses.action: Find Delwen after the screening and observe whether the visitor can act on the edited cue from the chosen viewing place.

name: Compose an exchange between two reasoned positions

uses.action: Give two records to the desk in a chosen order; their keepers answer one another before the next hearing is assigned.

name: Distil a transferable insight for a new context

uses.action: Bring a tested warning, its missing replies, the voice and the timed bridge into a new public trial with different responsibilities.

name: Preserve a specific object’s context when using an image

uses.action: Install the dated landmark image with a separate current stair instruction where an arriving carrier can use them.

name: Check the tone and attribution of a sensitive account

uses.action: Return the printed fragment to the speaker and issue a complete listening copy or her approved unsigned wording.

name: Check the integrity and sequence of a process record

uses.action: Use dated issue lines and the broken letter on two printed copies to recover which notice came first and which one cited a copy.

name: Combine research, reasoning and ethical judgement in a new case

uses.action: Reopen the public finding after checking all four keepers’ different records and give the affected households or the test crew the lead.
